before_changes.run_as: Roanv, logon type Interactive only (runs while the user is signed in, app open or closed; not when signed out)
triggers: Time trigger, repeat every 30 min indefinitely (anchor 2026-11-09 10:20:15, drifted on every reinstall)
before_changes.last_result_meaning: exit code 1 = run finished with days still waiting (RETRY: provider 503/unreachable, DE40 calendar mismatch). Not a crash.
findings: Task existed and was healthy; catch-up after a missed start was already on (StartWhenAvailable).
Last Result 1 on every run looked like a failure in Task Scheduler although it only meant 'retry later'.
The task ran the full sync on every tick; request volume was already bounded by stored backoff, but nothing decided whether a fetch was needed at all.
Install script anchored the repeat at now+1 min on each run, so reinstalling shifted the schedule.
No wall-clock-jump detection: after laptop sleep the in-app worker kept waiting out its remaining idle timer.

in_app_trickle.note: alive in the server on port 8767 (busy 20 s / idle 900 s); had no heartbeat field

changes_made_on_machine: Re-registered the same task name (Register-ScheduledTask -Force): action now `pythonw -m strategy_lab.data_check --scheduled --config ...`
Triggers: repeat every 30 min from a fixed anchor (00:00:15 local) + at logon; StartWhenAvailable kept, WakeToRun false, IgnoreNew, 2 h limit, restart 3x/5 min on failure
Scheduled runs now exit 0 when finished (days waiting is not a failure); non-zero means a real crash
No second task was added: one gated 30-minute task replaces 'daily + periodic' (a second one would only duplicate the lock-protected sync)

after_changes.task_started_manually_once: Start-ScheduledTask at 14:52:47 local -> LastTaskResult 0, ran with no app involvement

remaining_limits: Interactive-only logon: nothing runs while the Windows user is signed out (changing that needs a stored password or SYSTEM account; not done).
No wake timers: a sleeping PC fetches after it wakes (StartWhenAvailable).
